translation.name: U VURUNGAN ROF FOUN TEN GOV NANE JISAS KRAIS

book.name: Matiu
book.title: MATIU Vurungan Rof Nane Jisas Krais Te Kirkir Iny E Matiu

content: Tsue Fapapaar Nana Ina Safunuu Na Kooviou
“Tan nainy te tabin Mironyo a Waan iny Gormirmir te faarei nats non na ina safunuu na kooviou to te nom ir kurun fiisen men konobo tsuar ser nai tainytainy a isen a tsoiny fanging.
A ina ngim tsurin piou ana mes a ina ngim, u nat.
A ina ngim ton piou nom naan kurun tsuar ri gim to ma nom taatag naa tu mes tu konobo,
ana ri na ina ngim ton nat nom taatag naan konobo kaa naan kurun tsuar.
A tsoiny fanging vegits en naa mito, ana ina safunuun a kooviou tanik iny mata goros to ser goros famatmat ir.
“Te rot nana voiny tana voiny tsian an fikoo naa mito, ‘A tsoiny fanging to! Taami yam am tainytainy towa!’
A ina safunuu na kooviou tagun ri kakouiny ton kurun tsuar.
Ana ri na ina ngim a piou tsue to tana ina ngim a nat, ‘Faan mamimam yam tu konobo tsumi, tana saa, u kurun tsumam mats, sikia tu konobo.’
‘Sikia on,’ biny finy rari ri na ina ngim a nat, ‘U konobon sikia ma onot faavot rara. Kuar yam tana pan iny fafiifoiny am foiny to tu konobo tsumi.’
Ana ri na ina ngim a piou to, naa buser rato a tou foiny konobo, vou rari ana tsoiny fanging ruak to. A ina ngim to te kakoun naa fiisen mi towa tan guainy iny fanging ana ri siisiots ton pingping.
“Vou ana rin mes panainy kooviou piou ruak to sa ri tsue na ka, ‘Tsunaun, tsunaun! Fasof mamimam yam gagon!’
Sana tsoiny fanging tsue na ka, ‘Nyo tsue faman of maromi Nyo gim rou ma nat mami.’”
Ai Jisas tsue to na ka, “Kaa to yam, mi te kakoun tana saa, mi gim rom a natiny nainy ge na aua te tabin fatabin Mironyo.”
Tsue Fapapaar Nana Ina Pis A Tsoiny Binun
“Te faarei non a isen a mes te kakoun ma naus osing a fan a naa to tana gum fan veevian; ya fikoo raton tsoiny binun tsuan ya fakaa ratuari ma tagaa ot iny arin fo mamatsiny ka tsunia.

Ya fafaan ratuarin isiseiny tsoiny binun a painy moni ma tamainy yan fakats ana parits tsuri: tana isen ayei fainy ya na ngim a tapan moni, ya fainy to na mesmes a fuan a tapan moni, ana mesmes a isen a tapan moni. Ana ya naa busen nato tana gum fan veevian.
A tsoiny binun to te nom a ngim a tapan moni naa veesau tsun nato sa fabinun iny a painy moni to sa nom a mes a ngim a tapan moni.
Jesan kan te kat fi na mes a tsoiny binun to te nom a fuan a tapan moni ya faruak kainy to na fuan a tapan moni.
Sana tsoiny binun to te nom a isen a tapan moni naa to, kats a matan tan puputaa, ya famuiny to na painy moni tana tsunaun tsuan.
“Voun nainy viviakoo tana tou vavis tana tsunaun tana fo tsoiny binun tabin fatabin mito a tou nak rari tana fo painy moni tsuan.

A tsoiny binun to te nom a ngim a tapan moni naa mito sa faan iny a mes a ngim a tapan moni sa tsue na ka, ‘Nyi faan vanyo na ngim a tapan moni, tsunaun. Tagaa! A mes a ngim a tapan moni tovei to te vabinun iny anyo.’

‘Rof ovei tsun, nyi na tsoiny binun a rof ana kaa fasuu,’ te tsue fi na tsunaun tsunia. ‘Nyi kaa fasuu faarof fiisen me na painy moni ito na te ar karaup to sa nyo nai fakarap marom anyi ma tagaa ot iny anyi na painy moni a tee karap to. Taame ma paparaa fiisen vaminyo nyi!’
“Ana tsoiny binun to te nom a fuan a tapan moni naa mito sa tsue na ka, ‘Nyi faan vanyo na fuan a tapan moni to, tsunaun. Tagaa! A mes a fuan na tapan moni to te faruak anyo.’

‘Rof ovei tsun, nyi na tsoiny binun a rof ana kaa fasuu!’ tsue fi na tsunaun tsunia. ‘Nyi kaa fasuu faarof iny me na painy moni to na tee ar karaup, to tsonyo nai fakarap marom anyi ma tagaa ot iny anyi na painy moni a tee karap to. Taame ma paparaa fiisen vaminyo nyi!’

“Ana tsoiny binun to te nom a isen a tapan moni naa mito sa tsue na ka, ‘Tsunaun, nyo nat evarou nyi na mes a siireits; nyi agio rom tan tanun tana fo mes a fo vainy kaner, ana nyi te fag vavis a fo fua tan tanun tana mes a fo vainy kaner.
Nyo oraav, to tsonyo nai famuiny a painy moni tsumanyi koman puputaa. Tagaa! A painy moni tsumanyi to.’
‘Nyi na tsoiny binun a pisiin ana karous!’ tsue fi na tsunaun tsunia. ‘Fiisia nyi natiny a ka to, nyo agio tan tanun te gim ronyo ma fasito iny, ana nyo fag kainy to na fo fua te gima anyo ma reev?
Nyi tabuiny fasof a tee moni tsonyo tana guuv iny fatamaar ma nom fatabiny anyo ya fiisen me na tee ar moni patsun ya te tabin minyo.
Jio, nom osing yam a painy moni am fainy towa na tsoiny binun to te kaa minon a safunuu na tapan moni.

Ana mes kaa minon a nat, nyo fainy pis rou ya na nat fis pis non a nat te kaakaa mi ya ana ya te kaa me na nat a onot, sana mes te gim non ma komainy a nat nyo nom ravainy rou a nat a kakaii te kaakaa minon ya.
Ai tsunia na tsoiny binun a paku'ak to, gargar naa yam jiarasan tana uurup tana pan iny fasaraa, unya aya ayei nai tangis non ya te kakuts ngiisngiis a ngiisin.’”
Nainy Vaatsuk Tana Tsunaun
“Te tabin fatabin minon a Guei Tsoiny te Bobot e Gov sa ruak iny Mes me faarei minon Ya na Aatouf, an fo morena fiisen mi Ya, Ayei nai gum non tan tagan Tsuan tsigtsig.
Ana fo vainy faavot tana monaagits to te vaaguam faavot matan Ya. Ana Ya te kibei faavot rari tan fuan panaan, faarei te kibei finy non a tsoiny veis siip an meme:
Ya te nai fakei fuainy ir siip tan panaainy matou Tsuan an meme tan panaainy keeruk.

Ana Aatouf te nai tsue na ka tana vainy tan panaainy matou Tsuan. ‘Mi to te nom bus a parits ten Tamanyo: taami yam! Taami yam am fasito iny to na Waam mami te kakouiny of bus mami Tamanyo tan tatanik nana monaagits to.
Nyo te ves ana mi fa'ainy Vatuanyo, Nyo iinyu mi fajiu Vatuanyo; Nyo na ngap ana mi nom Vatuanyo numaa tsumi,
Nyo na beerbeer ana mi favau Vatuanyo; Nyo na faadis ana mi makok Vatuanyo, Nyo kaa to tan kotskots ana mi nak Vatuanyo.’
“Ana rin vainy tavaron nai tsue ror a ka Tsunia, ‘Farainy, Tsunaun, te tagei fi mam Anyi te ves mam fa'ainy Matuanyi, ge te iinyu Nyi mam fajiu Matuanyi?
Farainy te tagei fi mam Anyi na ngap ana mam nom Matuanyi numaa tsumam, ge kaa iny beerbeer Anyi mam favau Matuanyi?
Farainy te tagei amam Anyi te faadis ge kaa Nyi tan kotskots, ana mam nak Matuanyi?’
Ana Aatouf biny fatabin to sa tsue na ka, ‘Nyo tsue faman of maromi, u kat to te kat nats romi ten sei na vamuinyasiny Tsonyo iton vainy sikia tu asangan, mi kat kainy rom ya Tsonyo!’

“Ana Ya te tsue na ka tsuri tan nimainy keeruk, ‘Feis osing Vanyo yam, mi kaa busem fain na fasaraa ten Gov, kuar fi yam tan guaf sikia ma natiny mote te kakouiny e Gov of e Vinasaar an fuainy morena tsunia!
Tana saa, Nyo te ves sana mi gima fa'ainy Vanyo, Nyo iinyu mi gim to ma fajiu Vanyo;
Nyo kainy ngap mi gim to ma nom fi Vanyo numaa tsuam, Nyo beerbeer mi gim to ma favau Vanyo; Nyo faadis ana Nyo kaa to tan kotskots mi gim to ma makok Vanyo.’
“Ana ri te biny Ya, ‘Tsunaun, farainy te tagei amam Anyi te ves, ge iinyu, ge ngap, ge beerbeer, ge faadis, ge kaa Nyi tan kotskots, ana mam gim to ma faakouts Manyi?’
Ana Aatouf biny fatabiny ratuari, Ya te tsue na ka, ‘Nyo tsue faman of maromi te baainy fi mi ma faakouts ir vainy sikia tu asangan to, ami kan baainy Vanyo.’
Tan kat to aya, vainy nai nom rora tafan tsuar, ito na fasaraa na suu. Ai tsurin vainy tavaron nai nom ror a toto na suu.”
